figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of InvariRank. Structured attention blocks crosscandidate interactions, and shared positional framing aligns positional offsets across candidates.

Table 1: Reranking results on MovieLens-32M & Amazon Books with list length 𝐾 = 25. HR@k and nDCG@k denote Hit Rate and nDCG at 𝑘 ∈ {5, 10}, and Kendall’s 𝜏 , Spearman’s 𝜌 , and top-𝑘 agreement (T@5) measure permutation robustness. Higher is better for all metrics.
